name: zod-crawler
description: Infers a Zod schema from a set of sampled JSON API responses.

scripts.build: tsc -b && chmod +x apps/cli/dist/index.js && npm run build --workspace=@zod-crawler/web && npm run build --workspace=@zod-crawler/web-demo
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --force && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zod-crawler/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zod-crawler/web-demo && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zod-crawler/cors-proxy && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zod-crawler/site-router
